dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What a pity...

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: The problem is my personality... That, and luck not being on my side.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's funny, you know, the day before I signed up I even made a point of going out and buying this feather, which is supposed to bring good luck. Clearly, it had no effect whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: ...Well, no use complaining about it. Here, you can have it, maybe it works better on adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: ...Best if you say the bare minimum to me. I don't want to deplete my stamina.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: *sigh* If I'd known this would happen, I would have followed my dreams...

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Are you tired?

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: ...I'm a ship repairman. When the ships are at sea, I have nothing to do. But when they dock, I'm so busy I never get a wink of sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: So I have decided to conserve my stamina from now on. Otherwise, I won't be able to cope when the busy period hits.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you considered a change of occupation?

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Well, this job is rather busy, but being busy also means that there's money to be made.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: We have Rex Lapis' divine predictions to thank for that. The number of merchants going out to sea has increased year on year in recent times, which has led to our business being on the rise, too.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Those merchants who have made their fortunes aren't stingy, either. They often give us some tips on top of the repair fees.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Hard work begets an equal reward, and for the lads who want to earn some money while they're young, this job is pretty good. We shouldn't waste the opportunity that Rex Lapis has given us.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: What dreams?

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: ...I once had the opportunity to join The Crux, but by the time I signed up, they were full.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: I gave up on the idea of being a seafarer in the end, and went into ship repair work instead. Now I can only watch as the ships go in and out.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Maybe if I'd pushed a little harder for it back in the day, I wouldn't have ended up where I am now.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: And maybe the reason I've not been favored enough to receive a Vision is because I give up too easily.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: ...I hope you don't end up like me.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Now to focus all my energy on getting a good rest...
